skills.description: Studio name, address, hours, session times, and how booking works. Call this first before anything else.

skills.description: List open appointment times between two dates (YYYY-MM-DD, max 31 days, America/Chicago). Use to find a session time for the user.

skills.description: Check a held booking: pending, confirmed, expired, or cancelled. Use to follow up after handing the user the checkout_url.
skills.name: Get booking status
